_doc: Line pools for generated residents' dialogue. {name}, {job}, {town}, {holder}, {place} are filled in. Role-pack lines per job can be added under jobs.<job_id>.

good: Oh, it's you. {name}. Anything I can do?
neutral: Mm? {name}. I'm busy, but go on.
bad: I know what you did. Make it quick.
{name}. And I'd rather not be seen talking to you.

money: Wages don't stretch like they used to.
Coin's thin this season. Thinner than the ice.
safety: I bar the door at night now. Never used to.
Something's been taking sheep up the north road.
belonging: Don't know half the faces here any more. Everyone's new off the road.
Lonely town, for one this crowded.
conviction_arcane: The shrine's gone quiet. You can feel it in your teeth.
Machines everywhere and not a prayer answered.
conviction_gear: Nothing here works right. Clocks run slow, pumps seize. It's the shrine, mark me.
We'll never get anywhere while the old stones hum.
content: Can't complain. Well, I can, but I won't.

like: {holder} keeps the roads open. That's more than the last lot did.
dislike: {holder} takes and takes. One day there'll be a reckoning.
neutral: {holder}, the others, it's all the same to folk like me.

no_news: Quiet week. Too quiet, some say.
Only the usual: who's sleeping with whose cousin.

greet: Welcome to the {place}. Rooms upstairs, ale down here. {name}.
Peace on you. {name}, I keep the shrine.
{name}. Foreman. If you're looking for work, the queue's out back.
{name}, warden of {town}. Keep the peace and we'll get on.
